effect.name: Silhouette
effect.description: Fills the sprite with one flat colour and keeps its shape. Use a second copy of an object with this on it for a cast shadow, a ghost, an enemy seen through a wall, or the white frame of a teleport.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Colour
parameter.description: The flat colour the sprite becomes.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends between the original sprite and the flat fill.

parameter.name: Alpha Cutoff
parameter.description: Pixels below this are dropped entirely, which hardens a soft edge into a crisp shape.
